title: micp-biosafety-environment-auditor nitrogen mass balance
description: Urea-nitrogen mass balance contract (task brief §二). Conservation failure must block environmental conclusions (MBS-E301). All nitrogen quantities are in grams of N unless stated otherwise.

theoretical_total_n_g.description: Total nitrogen if all urea-N is accounted (2 N per urea).

nh4_upper_bound_g.description: NH4+ mass upper bound if ureolysis is complete.

nh4_n_upper_bound_g.description: NH4+-N upper bound (mass of N only).

nh3_potential_g.description: NH3-N potential if all nitrogen were volatile free ammonia.

residual_paths.description: Measured nitrogen sink paths ONLY. nh3_potential_g is a computed speciation potential (same N, not a separate sink) and lives at the top level — never double-count it here.

accounted_g.description: Sum of the measured nitrogen paths.

mass_balance_closed.description: True when |balance_error_fraction| <= tolerance. False => environmental conclusions are blocked.

uses_only_theory.description: True when no measured path was supplied; the balance is an ideal upper envelope only.
